# BONIIK

> BONIIK is Australia's premier Korean beauty and skincare retailer, offering authentic K-beauty products from brands like COSRX, SOME BY MI, Sulwhasoo, and LANEIGE with shipping across Australia and New Zealand.

Specializing in Korean skincare and cosmetics, BONIIK features products for sensitive skin, anti-aging, brightening, and acne treatment, with key ingredients like Centella asiatica, niacinamide, ginseng, and hyaluronic acid. The flagship store is located at BONIIK Hilton in Sydney, NSW.

## Key Topics

- Korean skincare (K-beauty)
- Centella asiatica
- Niacinamide
- Sodium Hyaluronate (Hyaluronic Acid)
- Sensitive skin solutions
- Anti-aging treatments
- AHA/BHA/PHA exfoliants
- Ginseng skincare
- Brightening serums
- Sebum control
- Cruelty-free products
- Vegan skincare
- BONIIK Hilton Sydney
- Australia Post shipping
- New Zealand delivery
